blocks.text: Ceramics sakht magar bhurbhure (brittle) materials hain jin ke melting temperature buland aur insulation ki salahiyat bohat achhi hai, is liye yeh zyada darja hararat aur bijli ke kaamon ke liye munasib hain. Kimiyai taur par in mein silicates aur alkali, alkaline earth metals aur aluminium ke oxides hote hain, jaise K2O, Na2O, CaO aur Al2SiO5. Mazboot bonds aur muqarrara banawat inhein mazbooti, pa-idari, aur zang aur hararat se bachao deti hai. Yeh bartanon, bhattiyon (furnaces), tiles aur sanitary ware (porcelain), khirkiyon aur optical fibres (sheesha), aur spark plugs (alumina) mein use hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si khasiyat ceramics ko bhattiyon ki tah ke liye munasib banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Un ka bohat buland melting point: yeh bohat zyada darja hararat par bhi thos rehte hain.

items: Ceramics: silicates aur oxides; sakht, bhurbhure, buland melting wale insulators.
Istemal: refractory eentein, abrasives, porcelain insulators, be-asar coatings.
